tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_fool.desc.base: Jump Boost I and -25% fall damage.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_fool.desc.asce: Jump Boost III, 100% fall immunity, and Double Jump.
12.5% chance not to consume tool/weapon durability.
50% chance not to consume durability and slowly repairs equipped items.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_high_priestess: -50% anvil XP cost and enhances held equipment enchantments by +1 level.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_empress.desc.b: -25% animal breeding cooldown & +25% baby growth speed.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_empress.desc.a: Instant baby growth, -75% breeding cooldown, and passive animals follow you.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_emperor.desc.b: Hero of the Village I (trade discounts).
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_emperor.desc.a: Hero of the Village V (huge discounts) and Iron Golems defend you.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_hierophant.des: +150% XP value (2.5x), long-range XP magnet, and heals when collecting XP.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_lovers.desc.ba: Regeneration I to nearby allies and tamed pets.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_lovers.desc.as: Regeneration II aura, and pets take -50% damage and deal +50% damage.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_chariot.desc.a: +40% Movement Speed, 1.0 Step Assist, and sprint safely across water and lava.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.strength.desc.asce: +50% Melee Damage and attacks bypass 30% of target armor.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_hermit.desc.ba: +2 Armor when isolated from other players and villagers (16 blocks).
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_hermit.desc.as: +8 Armor, +4 Armor Toughness, and reduced mob detection range when isolated.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.wheel_of_fortune.d: +0.5 Luck and 15% chance for +1 extra mining or mob drop roll.
+3 Luck and effective +2 Fortune and +2 Looting bonus drops.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.justice.desc.base: Reflects 15% of incoming damage back to the attacker.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.justice.desc.ascen: Reflects 75% incoming damage as True Damage and reduces damage taken by 15%.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_hanged_man.des: Converts 10% of damage taken into XP orbs.
Converts 50% damage taken to XP; grants Resistance III and +30% damage when below 30% HP.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.death.desc.ascende: +50% damage to all enemies, 15% Lifesteal, and executes non-bosses below 15% HP.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.temperance.desc.as: -85% hunger exhaustion, and eating any food grants Absorption II and instant healing.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_devil.desc.bas: Attacks set targets on fire (3s) and inflict Wither I.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_devil.desc.asc: Attacks inflict Wither III and fire; grants 100% Wither immunity and +35% damage to debuffed targets.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_tower.desc.asc: 100% explosion immunity, and heavy impacts trigger a non-griefing shockwave knocking back enemies.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_star.desc.asce: +2.5 block reach, +1.5 entity attack reach, and permanent Haste II.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_moon.desc.asce: Night Vision + in darkness or at night grants +25% Speed, Strength I, and Regeneration I.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_sun.desc.ascen: +20 Max HP (+10 Hearts), passive sunlight regeneration, and fire resistance shield.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.judgement.desc.bas: 10% chance to land a Devastating Critical Hit (200% damage).
tarotcardsrevamp.card.judgement.desc.asc: 30% chance to deal 250% damage with safe divine lightning, plus built-in Totem of Undying effect.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_world.desc.bas: Slowness I aura affecting enemies within 4 blocks.
tarotcardsrevamp.card.the_world.desc.asc: Temporal Aura within 8 blocks (Slowness IV, Mining Fatigue III, and slows incoming projectiles).
